entries.zh: 负重面向前方；朝、向（面向前方）
entries.en: to carry facing forward (in front); to face toward

entries.zh: 有理、在理；据实、真确（对理）
entries.en: to be in the right, reasonable; truly, according to the truth
entries.notes: 西语栏连读不清（carcar se dr … a saber la uer dad），释义依汉字「對理」与对音 tûy lŷ / tūy lī，并参西语 verdad（真理）定。

entries.en: to carry between two (persons); to shoulder jointly

entries.zh: 以竿担挑；擔（用扁担肩负）
entries.en: to carry on a (shoulder-)pole; to bear on a carrying-pole
entries.notes: 西语栏「2n un impalo doraç」连读不清（疑含 palo「竿」），据汉字擔/担担与对音 tān 定。

entries.en: to carry a thing with the hands; to hold, take up

entries.zh: 驮于牲口背上；牲畜驮载
entries.en: to load on a beast of burden; (of the beast) to carry on its back
to drive, harness (a beast of burden)
to press, press down; to weigh upon
to load the ship; to freight a vessel

entries.zh: 下落船（装货入船）；装船落舱
entries.en: to load (goods) into the ship; to stow aboard

entries.zh: 骰子灌铅（灌铅骰，赌中行诈）
entries.en: to load a die; to weight dice with lead (loaded dice)
entries.notes: 汉字末字有〔疑:骸〕之辨；依西语 cargar el dado 与对音 cûan çēn thâu 定为灌铅骰。

entries.zh: 怀身子（妇女怀孕；母怀子）
entries.en: to be pregnant; (the mother) to carry a child in the womb
entries.notes: 汉字次字有〔疑:身〕之辨；官话对音 huāy sēn chī 与西语 la madre…（niño）合证为怀身子。

entries.zh: 入铳药（给火铳装填火药）；装铳
entries.en: to load the arquebus; to charge a firearm with powder

entries.zh: 担担人（挑担的脚夫、搬运夫）
做脚（充当脚夫，为人挑运）
entries.en: to work as a porter (lit. 'make foot')
entries.notes: 闽南语栏另出「chose」一形未解；释义依汉字「做脚」与 Cargador 义定。

entries.zh: 夫马（人夫与马匹，供役搬运之运输力）
entries.en: porters and horses; transport labor (porter-and-mount service)

entries.zh: 轿埠（备轿承雇之埠站；轿铺）
entries.en: sedan-chair station, chair stand (where chairs and bearers are hired)
entries.notes: 汉字有〔疑:薦埔〕之辨，官话对音 guiān 亦近「薦」；依西语 carga de silla（轿）系与轿夫轿脚诸条定为轿埠（铺）。
汉字首字有〔疑:薦夫〕之辨；依西语 carga de silla 与通行义「轿夫」定。

entries.zh: 轿脚（轿之脚力，抬轿脚夫；或指轿脚钱）
entries.en: sedan-chair porterage (the bearers as the chair's 'feet'); chair fare
entries.notes: 汉字首字有〔疑:薦脚〕之辨；语义并存「轿之脚力（夫役）」与「轿脚钱（脚费）」两解。
